footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: Cushioned Running Shoes
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Breathable mesh upper with a foam midsole and a rubber outsole for road grip. Fits true to size and suits daily jogs and gym warm-ups.

reviews.body: Very light on the foot and the mesh keeps my feet cool on morning runs. Size 9 fit exactly as expected.
Good grip on wet tiles and the cushioning feels soft. Laces are a bit short but easy to swap.

footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: Lightweight Training Shoes
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Flat, flexible sole with a knit upper and a padded collar for gym sessions. Suited to weight training and short workouts.

reviews.body: Stable under heavy squats because the sole is flat and firm. Arrived in a sturdy box with no marks.
Snug around the heel in a good way. The knit looks a little loose after a few weeks of use.

footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: Trail Running Shoes
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Deep-lug rubber outsole with a reinforced toe cap and a water-resistant upper. Built for dirt paths and uneven ground.

reviews.body: Held well on muddy slopes near my town park. Slightly stiff at first but it softened in a week.
The toe cap saved me from a few rocks. Delivery came a day early.

footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: Court Badminton Shoes
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Non-marking gum rubber sole with a cushioned heel and side support panels. Designed for indoor courts and quick lateral moves.

reviews.body: Grips the wooden court without squeaking too much. Side panels feel strong during sharp turns.
Quality is decent but the shoe runs half a size small. Exchange took a few days.

footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: Walking Shoes With Memory Foam
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Soft memory foam insole with a flexible rubber sole and a stretch mesh upper. Made for long daily walks and light errands.

reviews.body: I walk about five kilometres each evening and these feel comfortable the whole way. Wide toe box is a plus.
Easy to slip on and pretty light. The grey colour shows dust quickly.

footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: Football Turf Shoes
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Synthetic leather upper with a studded rubber sole made for artificial turf. Offers a close fit with a padded ankle.

reviews.body: Studs bite well on our local turf ground. Needed a couple of matches to break in.
Neat finish and the ankle padding is comfortable. Packaging had a dust bag inside, which I liked.

footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: Sock-Style Sports Shoes
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Stretch knit upper that wraps the foot, paired with a thin cushioned sole. Works for light jogging and casual wear.

reviews.body: Feels like wearing a sock with a sole under it. Sizing is a touch tight so I would go one up.
Pulls on in seconds and looks clean with shorts. Colour matched the photos.

footwear-men-sports-shoes.name: High-Top Basketball Shoes
footwear-men-sports-shoes.description: Padded high-top ankle collar with a thick rubber outsole and a cushioned heel. Intended for outdoor and indoor basketball.

reviews.body: Ankle area feels supported on jumps and landings. The outsole is thick and shows no wear after a month.
A little heavy compared with my old pair but very stable. Box came slightly dented, shoes were fine.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Leather Oxford Shoes
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Full-grain leather upper with a closed lacing system and a stitched leather sole. A classic shape for office and events.

reviews.body: Polished up nicely and looks sharp with my suit. The leather was firm at first and softened after a week.
Good build for the price. The sole is a bit slippery on smooth floors so I added a rubber patch.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Slip-On Loafers
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Soft leather upper with a flat stitched vamp and a light rubber sole. Easy to wear for daily office hours.

reviews.body: Comfortable from the very first day and no heel bite. I wear them to work five days a week.
Looks good with chinos. Slightly roomy at the toe, so a thin sock helps.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Brown Derby Shoes
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Burnished brown leather with an open lacing design and a cushioned insole. Pairs well with both trousers and smart jeans.

reviews.body: The brown shade is rich and looks more expensive than it was. Laces were waxed and held tight.
Open lacing makes it easy to fit my high instep. Delivered in neat packaging with shoe bags.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Black Monk Strap Shoes
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Smooth black leather with a double buckle strap closure and a hard-wearing sole. Suited to formal functions and meetings.

reviews.body: Buckles feel solid and the shine is excellent. Wore them for a wedding and got several compliments.
Looks great but the straps were tight over my foot on day one. Loosened up after some wear.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Suede Formal Shoes
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Brushed suede upper with a lightly padded footbed and a flexible sole. Works for smart casual office days.

reviews.body: Soft texture and a nice navy shade. I keep a suede brush handy to keep it tidy.
Very light for formal shoes and comfortable for long hours at my desk.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Cap-Toe Lace-Up Shoes
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Polished leather with a stitched cap at the toe and a durable rubber heel. A traditional pick for interviews and business wear.

reviews.body: Wore them to an interview and felt confident. The cap-toe stitching is neat and even.
Fit is regular and the heel is stable. Arrived two days after the promised date but in good shape.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Patent Leather Party Shoes
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Glossy patent finish with a slim profile and a leather-lined interior. Meant for evening events and formal occasions.

reviews.body: High gloss that wipes clean with a damp cloth. A bit narrow, so check the width before ordering.
Looked great at a reception and stayed comfortable until midnight.

footwear-men-formal-shoes.name: Wingtip Brogue Shoes
footwear-men-formal-shoes.description: Perforated wingtip leather design with a Goodyear-style welt look and a sturdy sole. Suitable for work and weekend outings.

reviews.body: The brogue detailing is crisp and the sole feels thick enough for rainy days.
Heavier than my loafers but well made. Shoe tree would be a nice add-on in the box.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Velcro Strap Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: Three adjustable hook-and-loop straps over a contoured footbed with a grippy rubber sole. Good for travel and everyday wear.

reviews.body: Straps adjust easily so the fit is just right. Wore them through a long trip and my feet stayed comfortable.
Sturdy and dries fast after rain. The velcro makes a slight noise when opening.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Leather Kolhapuri-Style Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: Hand-stitched look in tan leather with a flat sole and an open toe loop. Inspired by traditional Indian craft styles.

reviews.body: Looks authentic and goes well with kurtas. Stiff for the first two days and then it moulds to the foot.
Good value and a strong tan shade. Sole is thin, so I use them mostly indoors and at events.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Sports Floater Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: Cushioned EVA footbed with a quick-dry strap and a patterned outsole. Built for light trekking and wet surfaces.

reviews.body: Handled a rainy weekend trip without trouble. The toe strap needed a few wears to settle.
Very light and the footbed has a bit of bounce. Delivered in a clean polybag with a tag.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Rubber Slide Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: One-piece moulded upper with a textured footbed and a flat rubber base. A simple option for home and the bathroom.

reviews.body: Perfect for home use and washes clean with a quick rinse. Does not slip on wet floors.
Comfortable and cheap enough to keep a spare pair. Colour is slightly lighter than shown.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Open-Toe Thong Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: Soft padded thong strap with a firm footbed and a durable sole. Designed for casual wear and short walks.

reviews.body: The strap is soft enough that there was no rubbing between my toes.
Fine for short walks but the footbed felt a little flat for me. Delivery was quick.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Braided Leather Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: Woven leather straps across the front with a buckle at the ankle and a cushioned insole. Gives a smart casual look.

reviews.body: Weave pattern looks neat and the buckle holds firmly. Good for summer evenings out.
True to size and soft inside. Straps are tight at first, then relax.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Adjustable Buckle Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: Dual buckle straps over a padded footbed with a rubber outsole and a heel cup. Offers an easy custom fit.

reviews.body: Two buckles let me set the fit for my wide feet. Sole has good traction on gravel.
Solid build and the heel cup keeps the foot centred. Box was a bit crushed on arrival.

footwear-men-sandals.name: Cork Footbed Sandals
footwear-men-sandals.description: Cork-textured footbed with a suede-lined strap and a light rubber sole. Suited to relaxed daily use.

reviews.body: Footbed shaped to my foot after about a week and now it feels custom.
Natural look and quite light. Straps could be a little wider, but overall happy.

footwear-women-flats.name: Pointed Toe Ballet Flats
footwear-women-flats.description: Soft synthetic upper with a pointed toe and a cushioned insole on a thin flexible sole. A neat option for office and outings.

reviews.body: Pretty shape and they did not pinch at all. I wore them all day at work.
Runs true to size and the black is deep. Heel lining is thin but fine for me.

footwear-women-flats.name: Embroidered Jutti Flats
footwear-women-flats.description: Cloth upper with colourful thread embroidery and a soft lining on a flat leather-look sole. Matches ethnic outfits and festive wear.

reviews.body: Embroidery is bright and neat, and I wore them with a lehenga for a family function.
Light and easy to dance in. The back was snug on day one.

footwear-women-flats.name: Bow Detail Flats
footwear-women-flats.description: Round-toe flats with a small fabric bow on the vamp and a padded footbed. Lightweight and easy for daily use.

reviews.body: Cute bow that stays in place. I went up half a size for a roomier fit.
Goes well with dresses and jeans alike. Delivered in a nice box with tissue.

footwear-women-flats.name: Slip-On Loafer Flats
footwear-women-flats.description: Smooth faux leather upper with a low heel and a flexible rubber sole. Practical for commuting and long days on your feet.

reviews.body: Good for my metro commute since the sole has decent grip.
Easy to slip on and the cushioning is good. A little loose at the heel until I added a pad.

footwear-women-flats.name: T-Strap Flat Sandals
footwear-women-flats.description: Slim T-shaped strap in synthetic leather with an ankle buckle and a cushioned insole. Works for summer outings and casual wear.

reviews.body: Elegant and snug on the ankle. They stayed put even when I walked fast.
Nice look but the buckle strap was a little stiff. Customer support helped with sizing advice.

footwear-women-flats.name: Mesh Cutout Flats
footwear-women-flats.description: Breathable mesh panels over a soft lining with a rounded toe and a light sole. A cool choice for warm weather.

reviews.body: Airy and light, and my feet did not get sweaty in the afternoon heat.
Soft lining, so no blisters. Colour beige matches many outfits.

footwear-women-flats.name: Metallic Flat Slippers
footwear-women-flats.description: Shimmering metallic finish with a padded insole and a non-slip sole. Suited to parties and festive evenings.

reviews.body: Catches the light nicely and the gold shade looked great at a wedding.
Comfortable for hours of standing. The shine may fade slightly with heavy use.

footwear-women-flats.name: Wide Fit Comfort Flats
footwear-women-flats.description: Extra roomy toe box with a stretch-panel upper and a soft foam insole. Made for wider feet and all-day use.

reviews.body: Finally a flat that fits my wide feet without squeezing. Stretch panels adjust well.
Great width and very soft inside. Would like more colour options.

footwear-women-heels.name: Block Heel Pumps
footwear-women-heels.description: Closed-toe pumps with a wide block heel of about two inches and a padded footbed. Steady enough for long office hours.

reviews.body: Wide heel gives real stability and I can walk the whole day. Looks professional with formal wear.
Good padding at the ball of the foot. I ordered a size up because my toes felt tight.

footwear-women-heels.name: Stiletto Party Heels
footwear-women-heels.description: Slim three-inch heel with a pointed toe and a satin-finish upper. Intended for evening events and short wear.

reviews.body: Beautiful finish for a party night. Best for a few hours rather than a whole day.
Looks lovely but the toe is narrow for me. Heel itself felt firm and well attached.

footwear-women-heels.name: Ankle Strap Block Sandals
footwear-women-heels.description: Open-toe sandals with an adjustable ankle strap and a chunky heel of about three inches. Pairs well with dresses and ethnic wear.

reviews.body: Ankle strap holds my foot in well and the chunky heel feels safe on uneven roads.
Comfortable and the buckle is easy to fasten. Colour is a touch brighter than the photo.

footwear-women-heels.name: Kitten Heel Slingbacks
footwear-women-heels.description: Low kitten heel with a slingback strap and a pointed toe in faux leather. Gives a smart look without much height.

reviews.body: Low heel that is easy to walk in and still looks dressy.
Strap has an elastic part so it stays snug. Packaging was careful and the pair had no scuffs.

footwear-women-heels.name: Platform Wedge Sandals
footwear-women-heels.description: Jute-wrapped wedge platform with a cushioned footbed and a crossed front strap. Provides height with an even base.

reviews.body: Wedge is much easier on my feet than a thin heel. Jute texture looks great with summer outfits.
Light for a wedge and the strap is soft. Used them for a day trip without trouble.

footwear-women-heels.name: Embellished Bridal Heels
footwear-women-heels.description: Stone and bead detailing across the front with a two-and-a-half inch heel and a padded insole. Designed for weddings and receptions.

reviews.body: The sparkle photographs well and the heel was manageable for the ceremony.
Beautiful work and fits as expected. A few stones felt loose, so handle with care.

footwear-women-heels.name: Velvet Pointed Heels
footwear-women-heels.description: Soft velvet upper with a pointed toe and a medium heel on a cushioned footbed. A rich choice for winter occasions.

reviews.body: Deep maroon colour looks rich and the velvet feels soft to touch.
Good comfort for a medium heel. Keep them away from water, since velvet marks easily.

footwear-women-heels.name: Peep Toe Court Heels
footwear-women-heels.description: Peep-toe design with a closed back and a three-inch heel on a lightly padded insole. Suits both work and dinner plans.

reviews.body: Classic shape and the nude shade goes with everything in my wardrobe.
Footbed padding is better than I expected at this price. Arrived on time.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: White Canvas Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Plain white canvas upper with a vulcanised rubber sole and cotton laces. A simple everyday pair for college and weekends.

reviews.body: Clean white look and easy to match with anything. Washed well with mild soap.
Fits true to size and the sole is flexible. Insole is thin, so I added my own.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: Chunky Platform Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Thick layered sole with a leather-look upper and padded tongue. Adds a couple of centimetres of height for casual outfits.

reviews.body: Lighter than they look and the sole gives a nice lift. Many friends asked where I got them.
Comfortable after the first day. The shoe is a bit wide, so I tied the laces snugly.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: Slip-On Knit Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Stretch knit upper with an elastic collar and a cushioned rubber sole. Quick to wear without laces.

reviews.body: Easy to put on when I am rushing for the bus. Knit feels soft and breathable.
Very light and fits well. The grey shade hides dust nicely.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: High-Top Canvas Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Ankle-height canvas upper with metal eyelets and a thick rubber toe cap. Gives a retro casual look.

reviews.body: Retro style and good support around the ankle. Lacing is simple and holds.
Looks great but the canvas was stiff for the first week. Fit was right in the end.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: Pastel Daily Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Soft pastel synthetic upper with a padded collar and a lightweight sole. Designed for casual days out.

reviews.body: The mint colour is lovely and looks just like the listing. Very light to wear.
Good for walking around the mall. Sole is a little slick on polished floors.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: Glitter Accent Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Low-top sneaker with a glitter panel on the side and a soft textile lining. Adds a bit of sparkle to everyday outfits.

reviews.body: Sparkle is subtle and does not flake. Lining is soft against the skin.
My daughter loves them and wore them to a trip right away. Packed with care.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: Velcro Walking Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Hook-and-loop strap closure with a breathable mesh upper and a shock-absorbing sole. Made for easy wear and daily walks.

reviews.body: Strap closure is a big help for me and the fit stays firm on long walks.
Breathable and soft. Colour is slightly duller in person, but still nice.

footwear-women-sneakers.name: Retro Suede Sneakers
footwear-women-sneakers.description: Suede-look panels with contrast stripes and a gum rubber sole. A vintage-inspired shape for casual styling.

reviews.body: Vintage look is spot on and the gum sole gives good grip.
Comfortable and well stitched. Runs half a size big, so check the size chart.
